note: Candidates built from observed evaluated breach signals only. Nothing is activated or sent. External-action candidates require separate approval.

candidates.trigger: a business-hours lead reaches 30 minutes with no first response
candidates.payload: a count and list reference of untouched leads needing an immediate first touch
candidates.guardrails: business hours only; Sales leads only; no customer contact is sent by the alert

candidates.trigger: weekly lead-to-set rate stays below the 25% target
candidates.payload: the set-rate trend and the appointment gap to target
candidates.guardrails: internal summary only; no automated customer outreach

candidates.trigger: weekly no-show rate exceeds its target
candidates.guardrails: internal only; any customer confirmation messaging is a separate approved action
